case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote with pride about the long years your family foundry has supplied us, and we feel the same about working with you. Option A is the package we can approve, and it gives your shop a clear, settled arrangement for the HN volute casings.

We looked at your offer carefully, and these points matter for a fair solution between our two family companies.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A fits these points best, and it also gives you the shortest payment term of the three. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship we share, and we appreciate your feedback. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the quality record and price history and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have also reviewed the quality data you provided and factored it into our revised calculation to find a fair compromise. 

To maintain our reliable supply despite rising costs, we propose a unit price of EUR 134.20 with 30 days payment. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.20 per unit. 

For our primary proposal, we can offer a price of €137.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This proposal remains valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for taking our points on board and for your warm words about the long relationship between our two family companies. You asked for a fair compromise, and our options below are our answer to that.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your foundry a clear, settled arrangement for the HN volute casings, with the payment term you proposed kept as it stands.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 126.70; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 127.42; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would like to see your family's loyalty answered with a firm, workable arrangement, and Option A is that arrangement.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised offer and for maintaining the 30-day payment term. In response to your movement, we have adjusted our calculation and can offer EUR 135.50 for this package. 

Under this proposal, we set a price of €135.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

This represents a fair step forward to secure the continued reliable supply of these casings from our family foundry. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You called your last offer a fair step forward to secure continued reliable supply, and we want the same: steady work for your foundry and a lasting arrangement between our two family companies.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a settled arrangement for the HN volute casings and a payment term that returns your cash faster, which we know matters to you. Since you have kept the old price for us before, we want a solution you can rely on in return.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 126.97; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship we share, and we appreciate your proposal of a 14-day payment term, which we gladly accept. In return for this adjustment, we are prepared to lower our price to EUR 134.00 per unit. While our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, this is the fair arrangement we need to confirm the package and ensure steady work for our family foundry.

Under these conditions, our Angebot stands at a price of €134.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

We agree, and that term is part of what we put in front of you again below.

Option A is the package we can approve. It returns your cash faster and gives your shop a settled arrangement for the HN volute casings. You kept the old price for us once, and we want to answer that with a solution both family companies can rely on.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 127.47; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

You asked what we need to confirm the package: we need a price that sustains our family foundry, which your current option does not. In response to your movement, we are taking another step and can offer EUR 133.50 for these terms. 

Please consider this our Angebot. Our proposal stands at a price of €133.50 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We take great pride in our craft and our long-standing ties to our region, and we always value our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Our current proposal remains valid for 7 days, and we hope it paves the way for our continued work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
